shared_elements: human figure in profile, low relief
figure holding a long staff or rod
decorative border band along the lower edge
procession/row of figures oriented in one direction
horned animal head motif (rams in A, horned/curved motifs in B's upper field)
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief human figures rendered in strict profile, at least one holding a long vertical staff, set above a horizontal dividing band, which is a broadly shared relief convention. But the depicted scenes differ fundamentally: A is a continuous procession of attendants driving large horned rams past a tree with a floral border below, while B is a compartmented panel with two figures flanking columns of sign-like markings beneath an arched lunette containing a winged/horned emblem, with no animals and no procession.
